scope: read only; preserve historical processes/mounts; no currently owned E2E worker remains after startup slice

argv:
import pathlib,os,json,hashlib
rows=[]
for p in pathlib.Path('/proc').iterdir():
 if not p.name.isdigit(): continue
 try:
  exe=os.readlink(p/'exe')
  if pathlib.Path(exe).name not in ('afs-node','afs-meta','fdbserver'): continue
  rows.append({'pid':int(p.name),'executable':exe,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(exe).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'starttick':(p/'stat').read_text().rsplit(')',1)[1].split()[19]})
 except (FileNotFoundError,PermissionError,ProcessLookupError): pass
print(json.dumps({'processes':rows,'afs_mounts':[x for x in pathlib.Path('/proc/self/mountinfo').read_text().splitlines() if ' - fuse afs-' in x]}))
